title.narrative: CONSTRUCTION OF A SANITARY CELL AT ALGHABAWI LANDFILL AND PURCHASE AND INSTALLATION OF A GAS TURBINE FOR THE EXPANSION OF THE LANDFILL GAS SYSTEM

description.narrative: The aim of the Project is to construct an AD Plant located in the Al-Shaer WTS designed to process 50,000 tonnes of food waste per year, equal to approximately 11 per cent of the organic waste collected. The envisaged AD Plant would produce 8 to 9 million cubic metres of bio-gas per year (depending on the food waste composition). The methane content of this gas will typically be 60 per cent to 68 per cent (depending on the waste composition) and should be sufficient to drive 3 to 3.5 MWe of generation, exporting between 20,000 and 25,000 MWh of renewable energy per year.
